total_value_eur: BW-Förderbaumaßnahmen ≈3,9 Mrd EUR Gesamtvolumen (davon ≈670 Mio EUR Landesmittel); übrige Posten regulatorisch ohne Einzelwert
highlights: Baden-Württemberg audit: 60% procurement error rate in €3.9bn of grant-funded construction; only 2 of 67 erroneous cases clawed back (Drucksache 18/307, 04 Aug 2026).
Bundesrechnungshof warns loosened procurement rules cut competition/transparency; >80% of 2009-era service/supply contracts were negotiated; NRW, BW, RP, Bavaria still extend easing.
Vergabebeschleunigungsgesetz raises federal direct-award limit to €15,000 and negotiated limit to €100,000; §97a GWB now allows single-lot infrastructure awards from 01 Jul 2026.
Defence acceleration law (BwPBBG) in force 14 Feb 2026; Bundeswehr sees only ~2.2 bids/procedure — low competition raises price risk.
